name: unattended
description: Leave Claude Code running and come back to finished work: resumes on its own after a usage-limit reset, and stops the agent from burning that new window on the same failing call.

autoResume.title: Auto-resume after a usage limit
autoResume.description: When a turn dies on a usage limit, wait for the window to reset and send the resume prompt for you.

resumePrompt.title: Resume prompt
resumePrompt.description: What is sent when the limit resets, as if you typed it.

resumeWindows.title: Windows worth waiting for
resumeWindows.description: five_hour waits for the 5-hour window only; a weekly limit stops for you. five_hour+seven_day waits for both, however long.

maxResumes.title: Resumes in a row
maxResumes.description: How many times it resumes without you typing anything in between. Then it waits for you.

fallbackMinutes.title: Retry when no reset time is known (minutes)
fallbackMinutes.description: API keys, gateways and some errors report no reset time: retry after this many minutes. 0 turns that off.

loopBreaker.title: Loop breaker
loopBreaker.description: stop refuses a call that already failed the same way several times in a row; warn only tells the model and you; off does nothing.

loopThreshold.title: Identical failures before stopping
loopThreshold.description: The attempt that would be number N of the same call with the same error is refused (counted per agent, reset by your next prompt).
